candidates.topic: New Moon in Libra — Solar Conjunction, Five Planets Retrograde
candidates.teaser: The sun and moon are sitting in the exact same degree right now — and five planets are retrograde at the same time. What does that actually mean for you?
candidates.video_title: New Moon in Libra — 5 Planets Retrograde at Once
candidates.video_description: Today's New Moon in Libra sits at 18° while the Sun is at 17.5° — an almost perfect conjunction. With five planets retrograde simultaneously, this reset carries unusual weight. A rare moment to turn inward while the sky pauses.
candidates.script: Five planets are retrograde right now — and today the Sun and Moon are sitting in the same degree of Libra at the same time. In astrology, a New Moon is already a reset, a blank page. But when Venus, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune, and Pluto are all moving backward while that reset happens? Astrologers call this a moment of compressed reckoning. The universe isn't just asking you to start over — it's asking you what you're even starting over for. Which sign are you?

candidates.topic: Venus Retrograde in Scorpio — What It's Undoing
candidates.teaser: Venus is retrograde in Scorpio right now — and in astrology, that's one of the most uncomfortable places it can be. Here's why.
candidates.video_title: Venus Retrograde in Scorpio — The Uncomfortable Truth
candidates.video_description: Venus rules love, value, and desire — Scorpio demands total honesty and fears nothing. When Venus goes retrograde in Scorpio, traditional astrology says old wounds and buried feelings come back to the surface. What you thought was resolved may not be.
candidates.script: Venus retrograde in Scorpio is not a soft transit. Venus governs what you love and what you think you deserve — Scorpio strips every illusion away until only the raw truth remains. In traditional astrology, this combination is said to surface relationships and self-worth wounds you thought were long buried. At 7° Scorpio right now, Venus is retrograde and moving deeper. The things you've been avoiding about love and money? They're coming up whether you're ready or not. Are you?

candidates.topic: Mercury Entering Retrograde Shadow — 14 Days Warning
candidates.teaser: Mercury isn't retrograde yet — but astrologers say the shadow period starting in two weeks is when things quietly start going wrong.
candidates.video_title: Mercury Retrograde Shadow Starts in 14 Days
candidates.video_description: Mercury goes retrograde on October 24, 2026 — but the shadow period, when its effects begin to be felt, is already approaching. Astrologers warn this is when communication glitches, tech issues, and unfinished conversations start to surface before the official retrograde begins.
candidates.script: Mercury isn't retrograde yet — but it goes retrograde in exactly 14 days, on October 24th, in Scorpio. And here's what most people miss: astrologers say the shadow period before the official retrograde is when the real disruptions quietly begin. Contracts, conversations, tech decisions — anything you start right now may need to be revisited. Mercury is currently at 12° Scorpio, heading straight into the storm. Do you know what you need to finalize before the 24th?

candidates.topic: Mars Conjunct Jupiter in Leo — Rare Fire Surge Still Active
candidates.teaser: Mars and Jupiter are both in Leo right now — and in astrology, that's the kind of combination that either launches you forward or burns everything down.
candidates.video_title: Mars and Jupiter Both in Leo — Fire Surge Explained
candidates.video_description: Mars sits at 7° Leo and Jupiter at 21° Leo — both in the same bold, fixed fire sign simultaneously. In astrology, Mars brings drive and Jupiter expands whatever it touches. Traditional interpretations call this a window of amplified ambition, visibility, and risk.
candidates.script: Mars and Jupiter are both in Leo right now — Mars at 7°, Jupiter at 21°. In astrology, Mars is the planet of action and Jupiter is the planet that blows everything up to maximum size. When they share a sign, traditional astrology describes it as ambition on fire — the urge to be seen, to take risks, to act bigger than feels comfortable. The question isn't whether the energy is there. The question is whether you're using it or just feeling restless. Leo placements, this one's for you.

candidates.topic: The Astrological 5th House — Pleasure, Creativity, and Risk
candidates.teaser: Most people focus on their Sun sign and ignore the one house that actually tells you what brings you joy — and why you keep sabotaging it.
candidates.video_title: The 5th House — What Actually Brings You Joy
candidates.video_description: The 5th house in astrology governs creativity, romance, play, children, and risk-taking. Often overlooked in favor of relationship or career houses, the 5th house reveals what you do purely for the pleasure of it — and what happens when you deny yourself that.
candidates.script: Your birth chart has twelve houses, and most people obsess over love and career — but the 5th house is the one astrologers say shows what you were made to enjoy. It rules creativity, romance, play, and the risks you take not for security but purely for the thrill. Whatever sign sits on your 5th house cusp describes your relationship with pleasure itself. And if you've spent years being practical, responsible, and serious — your 5th house is probably where the version of you that got left behind is still waiting. What's yours?
